review_evidence: The README identifies the repository as a Windows folder explorer written in Lean and documents only building/running the application with code-proxy.
The 22 Lean files implement UI/program states, filesystem objects, PowerShell/process integration, display constants, and the executable; there are no public mathematical theorem developments.
The only six theorem declarations are private mutual proofs that a hand-written Boolean equality for the File application datatype is reflexive/sound, used solely to construct its LawfulBEq instance.

source_action.content_invariant: The source is ordinary folder-browser application infrastructure; its private LawfulBEq discharge proofs are local implementation obligations rather than an independently addressable mathematical/specification/verified-semantics development.
